description: Implement ANY Linear ticket (pass --ticket) in a seeded enterprise repo (app | fender) ending on a draft PR. Nothing about the ticket is hardcoded; the agent fetches it from Linear during intake.

task.title: {ticketId}: implement Linear ticket
request: Fetch the ticket from Linear (use the Linear MCP) to read its full
description, acceptance criteria, and any linked Sentry issue, then
implement it in this repo. Keep the change scoped to what the ticket asks
for, and add focused unit tests covering the new behavior.

fender: NOTE — this is the fender repo, running in an isolated git worktree (no
direnv/Nix). To run tests/typecheck/lint here you MUST: (1) run
`yarn install` in the worktree first (Yarn PnP); (2) prefix commands with
plugin (CI is forwarded by turbo to package scripts; SKIP only covers the
outer call); (3) invoke turbo via `yarn exec turbo` (it's not on PATH under
PnP); (4) scope tests with `--filter=@klaviyo/<package>` — the bare
`turbo test` script is a stub that exits 1. Example:
`CI=true SKIP_DIRENV_NIX_ENFORCEMENT=true yarn exec turbo run test --filter=@klaviyo/performance-dashboard`.
